source_text: Nec illud respiciunt ceruicosi, setis rectis Quid? semper innocuos cruciarunt lege uitata. Sic Deo fecerunt, quod erant consueti, crudeles, Et filios sese audent adhuc dicere Summi. Iam qualiter <dominus> resurrexit, supra notaui, Non de uoce mea, sed dicta prophetica dixi. Praedixerat autem discipulis cuncta de sese, Qualiter a populo pateretur Petro negante; Et quia de tumulis resurgeret tertio die, Dixerat et ipsud, et compleuit omnia dicta. At ubi surrexit, uenit ad apostolos ipse Et stetit illis in medio: Pax uobis, inquit. Inter quos discipulos non adfuit unus orantes; Cui cum referrent, discredere coepit et addit: Si prius non digitum misero, ubi claui fuerunt Aut ubi percussus de lancea, non ego credo. Tunc die Dominica rursus remeauit ad illos Et stetit illis in medio: Pax uobis, inquit. Et statim adgreditur Thomam incredulum illum: Accede propius et contange corpus ut ante. Non ego sum umbra, mortuorum qualis habetur: Uestigium umbra non facit; considera uulnus. Extendit palmas; at ille tangere coepit Et manum in latere, fuerat quod lancea fixa, Misit et exinde prostrauit se<se> precando: Tu Deus et Dominus uere meus! Contra quem Haec quia uidisti, credidis<ti>, sed illi felices Posteri, qui credunt audito nomine tantum. Quadraginta dies cum illis ex ordine fecit, Edocuit illis multa, quae saeculo uenirent. Post cuius ascensum miracula multa fecerunt, De uerbo curabant infirmos in nomine Christi. Qui si talis erat, qualem isti perfidi dicunt, Fortia non fierent testium de uerbo per illum. Ascendit in caelos, sicut et scriptura canebat: Excipite regem, principes, caelorum in altis! Quid amplius opus est recitare cuncta de lege? Sufficiunt ista rudibus, bono corde tuenda. Quod si nec ipsi uolunt scire Deum ista legendo, Ipsi sibi reputent, quo uenerint, illo quo nolunt.
pass_a_gloss: Resurrexit tertio die — prophetica. Pax uobis. Thomas tangit. Beati qui non uiderunt. XL dies; ascensio. Miracula in nomine Christi. Tollite portas.
pass_b_english: Nor do those stiff-necked, bristles up, look at this: What? Always they tortured the innocent when the law was broken. So they did to God what they were used to, cruel, and still dare call themselves sons of the Highest. Already how the Lord rose I noted above — not from my voice, but I spoke prophetic sayings. But he had foretold the disciples all things about himself, how he would suffer from the people with Peter denying; and that he would rise from the tombs on the third day — he had said that too, and he filled all the sayings. But when he rose, he came to the apostles himself and stood in their midst: Peace to you, he says. Among which disciples one was not there praying; when they reported to him, he began to disbelieve and adds: If first I do not put my finger where the nails were, or where he was struck by the lance, I do not believe. Then on the Lord’s day he returned again to them and stood in their midst: Peace to you, he says. And at once he approaches that unbelieving Thomas: Come nearer and touch the body as before. I am not a shade, such as the dead are held to be: a shade makes no footprint; consider the wound. He stretched the palms; but that one began to touch and put the hand in the side where the lance had been fixed, and from then bowed himself praying: You are my God and Lord truly! Against whom: Because you have seen these things, you have believed, but those later ones are happy who believe by the name alone heard. Forty days in order he spent with them; he taught them many things that would come on the age. After his ascent they did many wonders; by the word they healed the sick in Christ’s name. If he were such as those faithless say, strong things would not happen from the witnesses’ word through him. He ascended into the heavens, as also scripture sang: Receive the king, princes, of the heavens on high! What more need is there to recite all things from the law? These suffice for the raw, to be kept with a good heart. But if they themselves will not know God by reading these things, let them reckon to themselves where they will have come — there where they do not will. ****** Third-day risen: Peace to you. Thomas touches; later ears are blessed. Forty days, ascent, healings in the Name — not a shade.
